signature_info.description: Microsoft Smart Card Reader Filter Driver

attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (native) x86-64, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is a legitimate Windows kernel-mode driver, specifically the Smart Card Filter Driver (scfilter.sys). It is a standard component of the Windows operating system responsible for managing smart card reader device nodes and filtering I/O requests for the smart card subsystem. The decompilation reveals standard Windows Driver Framework (WDF) patterns, including FxDriverEntry, EvtDeviceAdd, and various I/O completion routines. The driver implements PnP functionality (WdfScFilter_EvtDeviceListCreateSmartCardDeviceNode) and manages Raw Physical Device Objects (PDOs). Trace strings and file paths such as 'ds\security\scard\scpnp\filter\scfilter.c' and references to smart card GUIDs (GUID_DEVINTERFACE_SMARTCARD) confirm its identity as a valid system driver. No malicious behaviors or suspicious IOCs were identified.
